purpose: Test an exact published internal-weight edit on fresh synthetic arithmetic; bounded mechanism replication, not independent edit discovery or replication of the published benchmark score.
attribution: Takehi, Teoh, Zhang and Khattab, Sparks of Weight-Space Programming; published patch CC BY 4.0. https://github.com/RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs/tree/main/exp8_math

data.kind: Fresh procedural integer arithmetic, four equally represented families, plus exact-string instruction guardrails
data.seed_policy: Generate a new 256-bit seed remotely, retain it privately, commit its hash and generated cohort hashes before first inference. Never select seeds by model performance.
data.isolation: Coordinator controlled, not independently qualified. No former classification records reused. Final choices fixed before any final input is generated or evaluated.

selection: None: both arms fixed in this registration. Same per-case sampling seed in both arms; alternate arm order by case index. No prompt/decoder tuning, fitted classifier, gradient update or extra candidate.
uncertainty: 95% paired case-bootstrap interval, 10000 resamples, fixed seed 0; exact paired one-sided binomial test on discordant cases. Small synthetic cohort; no claim about general math ability or unrelated capabilities.
failure_policy: Write intent before each generation; retain errors and partial results. Never retry scored cases or overwrite this run. Any runtime/budget failure makes success unavailable. No token-bound changes after readings.

runtime_invariants: published patch Git object hash and exact bytes
all base and edited tensor SHA256 values
exact unchanged logits after edit restoration

differences_from_original: fresh synthetic questions instead of published benchmark sets
reuse of published patch rather than independent discovery
next_stage: A new editor loop requires its own registration, fresh evaluation cohort and pinned researcher prompt. It may use only this stage's development examples for diagnosis; final and guard results are spent.

publication.projection: package name and cache path generalized; bounds, model and patch identities unchanged
